subject: Re: DPA signature routing — signatory verification + status
body:
Message 1
From: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: LegalOps (Acme) <legalops@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final routing for DPA - signatory verification needed

Hi Sean,

Thanks for working with us on the DPA redlines. I've attached our internal signatory matrix and the latest redline (Acme_DPA_Redline_v3.pdf). We need to confirm two things before we send the envelope for signature:

- Whether Redwood will accept an authorized delegate (VP Finance) vs. the CFO signature on the execution page (our preference is CFO, but we can delegate if documented).
- Which e-sign vendor to use. Our corporate security team prefers AdobeSign for EMEA signers because of ID verification; otherwise DocuSign is fine for US-based signers.

Can you confirm Redwood's signatory acceptance and whether an access code + ID check is acceptable? We are aiming to have signatures complete by Friday 02-Oct.

Attachments: Acme_DPA_Redline_v3.pdf, signatory_matrix.csv

Thanks,
Megan Lee
Legal Operations | Acme Corp
megan.lee@acme.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

---

Message 2
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final routing for DPA - signatory verification needed

Megan,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Short answers up front:

- We can accept a delegated signatory (VP Finance) provided the person listed in signatory_matrix.csv is named as an authorized signer and we receive a scanned POA or an email from the CFO delegating authority. If it's just a name in a spreadsheet without backing documentation, Legal will require a POA or countersignature by the CFO.

- DocuSign is acceptable for US signers with an 8-digit access code + standard audit trail. For EMEA signers who require certified identity verification, we can switch to AdobeSign or use DocuSign's IDV product (but that requires an additional purchase and may delay execution).

Request to internal folks: Marissa / Karthik / Grace — can Legal confirm the minimum acceptable delegation evidence and whether we have existing IDV seats for DocuSign on the account? Also, if Acme insists on AdobeSign for the CFO, what's our operational preference (Adobe native envelope vs. have Acme send Adobe envelope and we countersign)?

I'll hold on sending any envelope until we confirm the path.

Best,
Sean
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0102

Attachments referenced: Acme_DPA_Redline_v3.pdf

---

Message 3
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Megan Lee <megan.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final routing for DPA - signatory verification needed

Sean / team / Megan,

Legal review notes and execution guidance:

1) Delegation evidence
- Acceptable: (a) Board resolution naming authorized signers; (b) CFO-signed delegation email with company letterhead; (c) notarized POA.
- Not acceptable: internal-only spreadsheets without signatory signature.

2) Vendor choice and ID verification
- If Acme's CFO will sign from EMEA and requests certified signer evidence, prefer AdobeSign certified signatures. If Acme sends an Adobe envelope, our counsel can countersign in Adobe.
- DocuSign is acceptable for US signers. We currently have DocuSign Standard seats but NOT the DocuSign IDV add-on on our contract. Purchasing IDV will take procurement 1–2 weeks, so not viable for the Fri deadline.

3) Envelope configuration (DocuSign)
- Access code: 8-digit numeric.
- Require signer phone/email verification (phone OTP) if available.
- Set recipient authentication method to 'Access Code + Email'.
- Add Redwood legal as manual CC with instructions to countersign after signature.

4) Adobe flow (if requested)
- Ask Acme to route a single Adobe envelope to Redwood; Legal will countersign and apply countersignature field.
- Ensure Acme includes signer name, title, and corporate email to match the POA/delegation.

Action items:
- Acme to confirm who will actually sign (CFO vs. VP Finance). If VP Finance, provide one of the acceptable delegation documents.
- Acme to indicate vendor choice (Adobe vs DocuSign).
- Redwood (Sales) to monitor envelope status and ping Legal for countersign after primary signature.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: None in this message (referenced earlier files).

---

Message 4
From: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: LegalOps (Acme) <legalops@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final routing for DPA - signatory verification needed

Thanks, Marissa.

Update from our side: the CFO (Elena Morales) will be signing, but she'll be in London on the 1st—so she prefers AdobeSign for certified evidence of identity. We can send you the Adobe envelope. Timeline: we'll route the Adobe envelope tomorrow (Thu 30-Sep local), aiming for an EMEA morning signature on Fri 01-Oct (her calendar permits a quick signing slot).

We will attach a delegation email from the CFO to the VP Finance in case a last-minute delegate is needed — but plan is Elena will sign.

Question for Redwood: if Acme sends an Adobe envelope, do you prefer we place Redwood (legal@redwood.ai) as the final recipient to countersign or send it to sean.gallagher first and instruct Redwood legal to countersign after primary execution?

Attachments: (will include delegation email if used).

Megan

---

Message 5
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acme.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final routing for DPA - signatory verification needed

Megan / Sean,

Confirming Redwood's preferred operational flow for an Adobe envelope: please route the Adobe envelope to legal@redwood.ai as a signer (Role: Countersignatory - Redwood Legal). That way our counsel receives the completed audit trail and can apply the countersignature field immediately after Elena signs.

A couple of operational checks for Acme before sending:
- Ensure "Signer Authentication" in Adobe is set to "Certified Identity" for Elena Morales.
- The "Signer Name" must match the name on the delegation doc (if provided) or the CFO's passport.
- Include a single PDF with the final DPA (Acme_DPA_Redline_v3.pdf) — avoid splitting into multiple docs to preserve page numbering for countersign stamp.

Fallback: if Adobe fails or Acme's admin prefers DocuSign, send DocuSign envelope to sean.gallagher (role: Primary Signer) with access code 8-digit and cc legal@redwood.ai for countersign. We will not purchase DocuSign IDV for this envelope.

Sales: Sean, please add a task in HubSpot to chase countersign status and escalate to me if not countersigned by EOD 03-Oct.

I'll standby to countersign as soon as the completed envelope is in our queue.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: signing_instructions.txt (internal stub)

---

Thread notes:
- Envelope planned: AdobeSign preferred for EMEA CFO; DocuSign acceptable for US signers.
- Required docs: CFO delegation or POA if delegate signs.
- Next steps: Acme to send Adobe envelope to legal@redwood.ai; Sales to monitor hubspot deal and escalate if countersign not complete by 2026-10-03 EOD.

"Onward; keep it simple, get the audit trail."
"- End of thread"
